title: Event
description: Canonical append-only event written to .agentic/journal/events.jsonl. One JSON object per line.

ts.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp with trailing Z (e.g., 2026-04-26T14:30:01.123Z).

type.description: Canonical event type. Adding new types requires updating this enum.

feature.description: Feature ID this event relates to (F-XXX, NFR-XXX, DEV-XXX, E-XXX), or null for non-feature events.

actor.description: Who emitted the event. Examples: lead, harness, teammate-coder, teammate-critic, hook:precommit_gate, cli:ag.

payload.description: Event-type-specific structured data. Free-form JSON object.

_truncated.description: Set to true when the writer truncated the payload to fit the 8KB soft cap.
